triage.evidence: _InitWatch.feed (agent_braid/harness_transport_claude.py:90-104) checks MAX_INIT_BYTES (:54) only while no newline is buffered (:97-99); a complete line of any size goes to _line (:106), and _read_stream (agent_braid/harness_host_claude.py:383) has no line bound either, so R8's 'fail-closed afterwards' wording is inaccurate. The severity raise is rejected: an oversized init is still route-checked live (agent_braid/harness_transport_claude.py:114) and in _terminal (agent_braid/harness_host_claude.py:453-455), and total output stays bounded by max_output_bytes. Restates R8.

The session egress is the delta of the loopback proxy's global counters (agent_braid/harness_containment_macos.py:1612, 1713), as R9 records. _egress_verdict (agent_braid/harness_qualification_probes.py:1239-1259) can turn a session without tunnels into denied only if another local client CONNECTs to an allowed endpoint in the window. A direct connection by the child is kernel-denied and never counted either way, so the error cannot hide an escape, only upgrade inconclusive to denied. Restates R9; severity raise rejected.
